svg.title: pos-nope
svg.desc: Llama 4 interleaves three chunked RoPE layers (chunk 8,192) with one full-attention NoPE layer. Toy masks with 16 tokens and chunk 4. Layer strips: Llama 4 Scout 36 RoPE plus 12 NoPE of 48 layers; SmolLM3-3B 27 RoPE plus 9 NoPE of 36, all full attention; Command A pattern three sliding-window RoPE layers (W = 4,096) then one full NoPE layer. KV cache of Llama 4 Scout at 128K in BF16: 7.1 GiB with iRoPE versus 24 GiB if all 48 layers were global.

text.font-family: STIX Two Math,Cambria Math,Times New Roman,serif
STIX Two Math,Cambria Math,Times New Roman,serif
